local p = {}

-- Card for pets (Pets, Powerstone Pet, Battle Pet): the Consumable look, with the skills in the description
-- as hoverable names (the same hover box as the mount and glider skills). Data: Module:Data/Pets/..., made by
-- sync_wiki_data.py; the skills' details come from Module:Data/Skills/...
local Consumable = require('Module:Consumable')
local Store = require('Module:DataStore')
local Mount = require('Module:Mount')   -- its hover box for a skill

local function trim(s)
	return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or ''))
end

-- "Relaxed Life" and "relaxed life!" are the same skill
local function key(s)
	return (tostring(s or ''):lower():gsub('[^%a%d]', ''))
end

-- {{#invoke:Pet|card|id=56039|float=|use=}}  (nothing when the pet is not stored)
function p.card(frame)
	local a = frame.args
	local d = Store.get('Pets', a.id)
	if not d or trim(d.name) == '' then return '' end

	local byName = {}
	for _, s in ipairs(d.skills or {}) do
		if s.name then byName[key(s.name)] = s end
	end

	-- the game writes the skill names as |nd;Name|r (light blue): those become hover boxes
	local function hook(code, inner)
		if code ~= 'd' then return nil end
		local s = byName[key(inner)]
		if not s then return nil end
		local sk = Store.get('Skills', s.id) or {}
		local html = Mount.hover({ args = {
			name = trim(inner), realname = sk.name or s.name or '', color = 'A3E3FD',
			cd = sk.cd or '', cast = sk.cast or '', mana = sk.mana and tostring(sk.mana) or '',
			desc = (sk.desc or s.desc or ''):gsub('\r', ''), icon = sk.icon or s.icon or '',
		} })
		return (html:gsub('\n', ' '))
	end

	return Consumable.render(frame, d, { float = a.float, use = a.use, hook = hook, nosell = false })
end

return p
